# CMRIT Placement Portal

> Previous-year campus-placement interview questions from companies that recruited at
> CMR Institute of Technology (CMRIT), Bengaluru, India. Questions are compiled from
> students' own recollections after their drives, organised by company and placement season.

## Facts

- Questions: 2,818 across 172 companies
- Placement seasons covered: 2022-23 to 2026-27
- Rounds covered: Technical, Programming (coding), and HR
- Free tier: the company list, placement seasons and the number of technical, coding and HR questions each company has. Question text itself is behind the pass.
- Paid tier: the full technical and coding bank, notes, AI answers and mock interviews
- Sign-in is restricted to @cmrit.ac.in accounts; the question pages are public

## Accuracy and limits

- Questions are recalled by students after the fact, so wording may differ from what
  was asked verbatim on the day.
- The site is an independent student resource. It is not an official publication of
  CMR Institute of Technology, and it is not affiliated with any company listed.
- Company names and logos belong to their respective owners and are used only to
  identify which company asked which questions.
